quote: Severe soil degradation made successful planting difficult
practice_context: Community mangrove restoration, Pyindaye Reserved Forest, Myanmar; case includes abandoned-paddy planting and degraded-forest enrichment
variable_use: Observed establishment difficulty reported as a project challenge; not a suitability calculation.
direction: Adverse effect of severe existing degradation on planting success. No measured monotonic severity-response function established.
calibration: No soil metric, severity scale, threshold, response score or weight.
mapping_hold: Observed soil degradation state cannot be replaced by soil_degradation_risk or soil_degradation_sensitivity. No ontology change made.

source_lineage: Case cites FREDA & ACTMANG (2012), Springate-Baginski et al. (2011), Webb et al. (2014); individual primary attribution not resolved.
